analysis.title: Goldman: this is the most panic we've seen in a very long time
key_insights: NASDAQ VIX had its biggest 1-day move since Covid and is back near Liberation Day levels. VVIX rose nearly 45 points on the day, the 2nd largest 1-day move higher ever, behind only Volmageddon.
High Beta Momentum fell 6.2% and is now 51% off its June highs, the worst drawdown in more than 10 years.
SOX fell 12%, its worst day since 2020. It is now 38% below its local highs and 14% below its 200-day moving average, close to a double bear-market drawdown.
ETFs took 32% of tape volume, their largest share since June.
Many GS AI-related baskets had their biggest down day since the launch of ChatGPT, described as a 4-sigma move.
GS Prime shows TMT hedge funds with a hit of more than 400bp in one day. Hedge funds are roughly flat to slightly positive YTD, down from about +24% before the June/July AI sell-off.

The Mag7 was expected to benefit from the Midterms (less compute being built, more pricing power for scaled players). The initial buying reversed quickly and the group had one of its largest declines in years.
The worst-performing themes were high beta, robotics, quantum computing and non-profitable tech.
The industrials momentum pair had its second worst day on record (data since 2013), so the sell-off was not confined to tech.
The GS vol desk said: "This is the most panic we've seen in a very long time."
